selection: Discovery residual= native L17 bilinear write minus compiled m16 prediction. Energy PCA and Fisher-weighted reduced-rank linear reconstruction; Fisher estimated from categorical native-softmax score gradients,16/64 nested samples per discovery site, exact final RMS/linear/tanh derivative. Metric is averaged over discovery states; correlations between state metric and error are not explicitly fitted. All bases frozen before test.

gates.small_residual_repairs: At least one predeclared rank<=16 energy/Fisher restoration reduces native-to-restored KL by>=80% versus compiled and has CE increase<=.02 nats and native top1 agreement>=.98.
gates.fisher_advantage: Both Fisher sampling variants at rank16 lower exact test KL by>=25% versus energy PCA16.

scope: Oracle native residual coefficients on test, not a compact forward model.64 discovery/test documents each, disjoint complete-document hashes; reused evaluation panel. Fisher is Monte Carlo native-distribution score covariance, not observed-label gradient covariance or exact full Fisher. Oblique Fisher reconstructions may worsen Euclidean error. Report all fixed ranks/random controls, numerical full restoration, KL/CE/margins/top1 and residual energy.
